logo_override.validation_detail: webfetch probe of the asset returned 'Image fetched successfully', i.e. HTTP 200 with an image content type and no HTML/WAF body; raw GET confirms 200, image/png, 4484 bytes, 278x84, Format32bppArgb with only 25.0% of pixels non-transparent; composited on a white canvas it measures mean luminance 216 with 16.2% dark and 78.9% light pixels, i.e. the navy interlace device and the dark navy 'The American University in Cairo' wordmark stay legible on a light card, so no white-on-transparent failure
logo_override._award: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at The American University in Cairo

notes: Awarding body for target 724 is The American University in Cairo (the Mastercard Foundation is the partner funder, not the awarding body, and its mark is not served by aucegypt.edu, so rule 1 rules it out anyway); under rule 2 the correct mark is AUC's own university lockup, so image_kind is official_university. Hard case: on the main site (Drupal 11, custom theme auc_ss) the AUC logo is NOT a file. Both the header and the footer logo are inline in that page's markup), which is the full dark navy device + 'The American University in Cairo' wordmark with a 'Libraries and Learning Technologies' sub-line, 278x84, dark on transparent so it renders correctly on a light card. Caveat for the merger: it carries the library sub-brand sub-line, but the wordmark itself is the university's, and the asset is served from the same registrable domain aucegypt.edu as required by rule 1; if a strictly sub-brand-free mark is wanted, the only file-backed alternative on the host is the 32x31 favicon.
